LESSON: PEACE AND CONFLICT RESOLUTION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: GOVERNANCE Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Exper
Topic 5.1: Peace and Conflict Resolution
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Peace and Conflict Resolution, part of GOVERNANCE Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Exper in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we embrace peace in society? 2. How could we live peacefully with others in society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Peace and Conflict Resolution together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners examine community needs as they create songs and poems on peace.

● Creativity and imagination: Learners role-play peaceful methods of resolving conflicts in school.

Values:
● Unity: Learners collaborate with others as they design a poster on ways of promoting peace and display in class.

56

● Responsibility: Learners proactively solve problems as they write essays on ways of promoting peace.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Self- esteem: Learners role-play peaceful methods of resolving conflicts in school.

● Peace education: Learners discuss peaceful methods of resolving conflicts in society.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

 Learners apply Religious studies knowledge as they discuss peaceful methods of resolving conflicts in society.

 Learners use Creative Arts skills to role-play peaceful methods of resolving conflicts in society.
